description: Use official MicroG-RE 7.2.1 for Google Maps and synthesized navigation speech. Includes an opt-in native EV model experiment that sends BYD battery data and estimated road-load coefficients to Google. Arrival forecasts and navigation display remain experimental.

patches.name: BYD native battery experiment
patches.description: Experimental: sends this BYD's battery and road-load model to Google through Maps' native EV route requests. Starts from the car's own average consumption, learns slowly from BMS energy/distance, and adds in-app vehicle settings. Native hooks inspected on Maps 26.41. Targets BYD DiLink 3; DiLink 5 unverified.

options.description: Experimental: shows an inline battery icon and Google's arrival percentage after ETA.

patches.name: Google Maps for MicroG-RE
patches.description: Connects supported Google Maps builds to MicroG-RE 7.2.1 and prefers synthesized navigation speech with the existing audio fallback.

release_notes:
- New: BYD native battery experiment (optional). It sends the car's battery level and an estimated road-load model to Maps' EV route requests, so route preview and navigation show the battery percentage at arrival.
- Maps → Settings → Vehicle and battery offers Automatic (learns from the car), Fixed or Manual A/B/C. Battery capacity is measured automatically.
- Google Maps for MicroG-RE: navigation speech works on Maps 26.41.

Tested on a BYD Dolphin, DiLink 3.0 with Maps `26.41.04.993332563` and MicroG-RE 7.2.1.

Limitations: BYD DiLink 3.0 and Maps 26.41 only. Other models and DiLink 5.0 are untested.
